datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators across Burkina Faso on a regular schedule (approximately quarterly in 2014: January, April, July, October). Spatial data were compiled into GeoJSON files representing near-term projected food insecurity conditions at sub-national administrative units. The dataset supports humanitarian food security monitoring and disaster risk analysis by quantifying population-level food insecurity severity.
